description: This file defines a Vue-like component named 'Carousel' using the Blits framework. It includes component configuration such as template, state, hooks, input handlers, and methods, with a focus on fetching data asynchronously within the component.

classes.name: Carousel
classes.description: A component that displays a carousel of items with data fetched from an API.

methods.name: fetchData
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches data for movies, TV shows, and documentaries for the current page and updates the items state.
